responsibility: This machine-description fragment defines the H8/300 move and push instruction patterns for QI/HI/SI/SF data, including strict-low-part stores, H8SX short-immediate moves, MAC register transfers, and stack push forms. It owns the mapping from generic mov and push RTL to the target’s register/memory transfer encodings, invokes backend helpers such as h8300_move_ok and compute_mov_length to validate and size alternatives, and supplies CC-clobbering variants and splits that make move semantics usable throughout reload, compare elimination, and prologue generation.
